title: TUI writes heal a stale render like CLI writes
lead: s417 made every locked CLI write regenerate a stale or conflicted `.slicer/render/` first. TUI writes call `ops` directly after `vcs.require_no_merge` and do not heal, so a merge followed by TUI-only edits leaves the render stale until a CLI write or the TUI's `r` key.
findings_note: s417 review 2026-10-30, later note: TUI saves do not regenerate a stale or conflicted render/
boundary: **Not in this slice:** healing in the relay-run ledger, feedback commands, `init`, `setup-git --attributes` or `ai relay --init-roles`.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: docs/commands.md and the CHANGELOG list the TUI as a write path that does not heal. An owner who works in the TUI after a merge sees `check` fail on a stale render with no hint from the TUI.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `src/slicer/tui.py`: `begin_write`/`heal_render` call `ops.heal_render(state)` after `vcs.require_no_merge`; `act`, `apply_edit_result`, the catalog cite, move, note (handoff, reject, retract) prompts and `View._save_wizard` use them and put the heal line in the status message.
- `docs/commands.md`, `docs/tui.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`: drop the TUI from the list of writes that do not heal and describe the status-line message.
- `tests/test_render_heal.py`: `TuiRenderHealTests`, a TUI write with a stale render heals it; `tests/test_tui_style.py`: an in-memory test patches `ops.heal_render`.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body: - `test_Tui_WriteWithStaleRender_HealsAndSaysSo` (in `tests/test_render_heal.py`): a fixture with a stale ROADMAP.md, a TUI note save, and the render matches the pre-write state afterwards with the heal line in the status message. It fails today.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Reuse `ops.heal_render` from s417; skip during a merge as the CLI does.
2. Surface the regenerated file names in the TUI status line, not stderr.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: - `python3 tests/affected.py --run`, then the full suite. `slicer check` passes.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: One commit on the slice branch.
